tools_used: public Supreme Court filing retrieval with urllib and pypdf
helpful: Exact reached-rate denominators permit pooling strictly prior Terms without rounding error.
Snapshot document URLs enabled retrieval of the newly submitted supplemental brief without a current-docket search.
Primary opinion excerpts helped distinguish the statutory provisions behind the alleged circuit split.
gaps: The supplemental brief and lower-court opinion were not provisioned alongside the petition.
Web-tool calls returned no visible results; the lower-court citation search also returned no match.
Long shell and MCP responses were truncated; smaller targeted excerpts were needed.
notes: The default uv cache was read-only; a temporary cache worked. pdftotext was absent, but the installed pypdf library successfully extracted the exact public supplemental filing in memory. No corpus query or CourtListener REST fallback was used.
